import Mathlib.Algebra.MonoidAlgebra.Degree
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Eval
import Mathlib.Order.ConditionallyCompleteLattice.Finset
import Mathlib.Basic.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.Weight
import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPowerSeries.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.Tactic
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.RingDivision
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FreeModule.PID
import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPolynomial.Localization
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.Integer
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.FractionRing
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.GaussLemma
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.RationalRoot
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.DenomsClearable
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Archimedean.Real.Basic

#check_failure Roth.Θ_option_le
#check @Real.sSup_le
#check @csSup_le
#check @Finset.le_sup'_of_le
#check @Finset.le_sup'_iff
#check @Finset.sup'_le_iff
#check @AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree
#check @MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_mul
namespace ThetaOption214Isolated
theorem abstract {α ι : Type*} [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α] {S : Set α}
    (hS : S.Nonempty) {s : Finset ι} (hs : s.Nonempty) (g : ι → α)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ i ∈ s, x ≤ g i) : sSup S ≤ s.sup' hs g :=
  csSup_le hS fun x hx ↦ by
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := h x hx
    exact Finset.le_sup'_of_le g hi hxi
theorem real {ι : Type*} {S : Set ℝ} {s : Finset ι} (hs : s.Nonempty) (g : ι → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ i ∈ s, x ≤ g i) (h0 : 0 ≤ s.sup' hs g) :
    sSup S ≤ s.sup' hs g :=
  Real.sSup_le (fun x hx ↦ by
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := h x hx
    exact Finset.le_sup'_of_le g hi hxi) h0
theorem witness_iff {ι : Type*} {s : Finset ι} (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (g : ι → ℝ) (a : ℝ) : a ≤ s.sup' hs g ↔ ∃ i ∈ s, a ≤ g i :=
  Finset.le_sup'_iff hs
theorem empty_guard :
    (∀ x ∈ (∅ : Set ℝ), x ≤ -1) ∧ ¬sSup (∅ : Set ℝ) ≤ -1 := by
  simp [Real.sSup_empty]
theorem zero_order_guard (w : Unit → ℕ) :
    MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (0 : MvPowerSeries Unit ℝ) = ⊤ :=
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_zero w
#print axioms abstract
#print axioms real
#print axioms witness_iff
#print axioms empty_guard
#print axioms zero_order_guard
end ThetaOption214Isolated

  s.Nonempty → (∀ b ∈ s, b ≤ a) → sSup s ≤ a

@Finset.le_sup'_of_le : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : SemilatticeSup α] {s : Finset β} (f : β → α) {a : α}
  {b : β} (hb : b ∈ s), a ≤ f b → a ≤ s.sup' ⋯ f

@Finset.le_sup'_iff : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : LinearOrder α] {s : Finset ι} (H : s.Nonempty) {f : ι → α}
  {a : α}, a ≤ s.sup' H f ↔ ∃ b ∈ s, a ≤ f b

@Finset.sup'_le_iff : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : SemilatticeSup α] {s : Finset β} (H : s.Nonempty)
  (f : β → α) {a : α}, s.sup' H f ≤ a ↔ ∀ b ∈ s, f b ≤ a

@AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree : {R : Type u_1} →
  {A : Type u_2} →
    {T : Type u_3} →
      [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : SemilatticeInf T] → [OrderTop T] → (A → T) → AddMonoidAlgebra R A → T
